summary: Keeps an object sitting on the ground, optionally tilted to the slope. Runs at runtime.
overview: Raycasts down and repositions the object onto whatever is below, optionally rotating it to match the surface. Distinct from the editor-time Greybox Placer: this runs in play, continuously if you want.
useCases: Props that must stay on uneven terrain as it changes.
Objects on a moving platform that should track its surface.
Dropping spawned items onto the ground without physics.

params.tuning: The ray starts this far ABOVE the object. Too small and an object already slightly sunk can never find the surface it is inside.
Right for crates and rocks, wrong for anything that should stay upright like a character or a signpost.
Only needed for moving surfaces. Otherwise one snap on enable is enough, and far cheaper.

gotchas.title: It snaps the pivot, not the base
gotchas.body: A model whose pivot sits at its centre will end up half-buried. heightOffset is the adjustment, but a pivot at the foot of the mesh is the real fix.
